name: dsk
description: Claude Code plans, reviews and decides; a DeepSeek worker scouts the code and writes it: the skill, a reviewer agent, the review gate, and an optional live display of the jobs (/dsk-jobs on).

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: official: DeepSeek's own API, which needs only the DeepSeek API key. custom: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint that serves a DeepSeek model, which needs the three custom fields.

deepseek_api_key.title: DeepSeek API key
deepseek_api_key.description: The key from DeepSeek's API platform. Needed for provider official. With provider custom it is optional: it adds the official API as a fallback and makes web search (--web) available.

custom_base_url.title: Custom endpoint URL
custom_base_url.description: Provider custom only. The base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, such as https://example.com/v1.

custom_model.title: Custom model name
custom_model.description: Provider custom only. The model id as that endpoint lists it.

custom_api_key.title: Custom API key
custom_api_key.description: Provider custom only. The API key for that endpoint.
